D: Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by three ghosts on Christmas Eve in this motion-capture take on the Dickens story.
P: Serve the main when Scrooge sends the prize turkey to the Cratchits.
S: Fezziwig's ball pork and sage rolls
Pork, apple and sage sausage rolls in puff pastry

Little puff pastry sausage rolls filled with pork, sage and apple, glazed golden and served warm with a sharp mustard and apple chutney. Mix 500g pork mince with 1 grated apple, 1 grated onion, 2 tbsp chopped sage, 40g breadcrumbs, salt and pepper. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry in half. Lay a log of filling along each strip, roll and seal underneath. Brush with 1 beaten egg and cut each into 5 small rolls. Bake at 200C for 22 minutes until golden. Serve warm with 150g apple chutney stirred with 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard.
Roasted chestnuts tossed in brown butter, rosemary and sea salt

Hot roasted chestnuts tossed in nutty brown butter, rosemary and sea salt, served in paper cones like a London street stall. Cut a cross through the shell on the flat side of 600g fresh chestnuts. Soak in water for 10 minutes, then drain. Roast on a tray at 200C for 20 to 25 minutes until the shells peel back. Wrap in a tea towel for 5 minutes, then peel while warm. Melt 40g butter until golden brown and nutty, add a sprig of chopped rosemary and toss the chestnuts through with sea salt. Serve in paper cones.
M: Scrooge's prize turkey with sage stuffing
Butter roast turkey breast with sage and onion stuffing

Butter-roasted turkey breast with sage and onion stuffing, apple sauce, roast potatoes and a rich gravy, a feast for the Cratchits. Rub a 1.5kg turkey breast with 40g butter, salt and pepper and roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Mix 150g breadcrumbs, 1 diced onion fried in 30g butter, 2 tbsp chopped sage and 1 egg, press into a dish and bake for the last 30 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes in oil alongside. Simmer 3 peeled diced apples with 2 tbsp sugar and water until soft. Make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour and 400ml stock.
W: Steamed Christmas pudding with warm vanilla custard

A rich steamed fruit pudding with a sprig of holly on top, served in wedges with thick homemade custard and brandy butter cream. Steam an 800g Christmas pudding over simmering water for 1 hour, or follow the packet. Warm 500ml milk with 100ml cream. Whisk 4 egg yolks, 60g caster sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour, pour in the milk while whisking, return to the pan and stir until thick. Add 1 tsp vanilla. Whip 200ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and 1 tsp orange zest. Turn out the pudding, top with a holly sprig and serve with both.
K: Warm red grape juice with roasted clove oranges, apple and ginger

An alcohol-free take on Dickens's hot punch: roasted clove-studded oranges warmed with red grape juice, cinnamon and honey. Stud 2 oranges with 6 cloves each and roast at 200C for 20 minutes until browned. Slice them into a saucepan with 1L red grape juice, 250ml apple juice, 2 cinnamon sticks, 2 tbsp honey and 3 slices fresh ginger. Heat gently for 15 minutes without boiling. Ladle into heatproof glasses or mugs with an orange slice in each.

dishes.n: Fezziwig's ball pork and sage rolls
dishes.make_ahead: Roll the logs up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled; brush with egg, cut and bake on the night

steps.text: Mix the pork with the apple, onion, sage, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper.
Cut the pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll and seal underneath.
Brush with egg and cut each into small rolls.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Stir the mustard into the chutney and serve alongside.

veg.n: Fezziwig's ball lentil, apple and sage rolls
veg.make_ahead: Cook the lentil and mushroom filling and roll the logs up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; glaze, cut and bake on the night

ingredients.item: eggs (1 for the filling, 1 beaten for glazing)

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil until dry and golden, then cool.
Lightly mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, apple, onion, sage, breadcrumbs, one egg, salt and pepper.
Cut the pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll and seal underneath.
Brush with the other egg and cut each into small rolls.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Stir the mustard into the chutney and serve alongside.

dishes.make_ahead: Roast and peel the chestnuts up to 1 day ahead, covered; brown the butter and toss them through just before serving

steps.text: Cut a cross through the shell on the flat side of each chestnut.
Soak in water, then drain.
Roast on a tray at 200C until the shells peel back.
Wrap in a tea towel to steam, then peel while warm.
Melt the butter until golden brown, add the rosemary and toss the chestnuts through with sea salt. Serve in paper cones.

dishes.n: Scrooge's prize turkey with sage stuffing
dishes.make_ahead: Mix the stuffing and stew the apples up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; roast the turkey and potatoes on the day

steps.text: Rub the turkey with some of the butter, salt and pepper.
Roast at 180C.
Fry the onion in butter, mix with the breadcrumbs, sage and egg, press into a dish and bake alongside for the last part of the roasting. Roast the potatoes in oil.
Simmer the apples with the sugar and water until soft.
Rest the turkey. Make gravy from the pan juices with the flour and stock.

veg.n: Scrooge's prize mushroom wellington with sage stuffing
veg.make_ahead: Wellington can be assembled up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cook the mushrooms in 20g of the butter until all the liquid is gone. Cool.
Fry the onion in 30g of the butter, then mix with the breadcrumbs, sage and 1 egg for the stuffing.
Overlap the pastry sheets, spread with the stuffing, spoon the mushrooms down the middle, roll up, seal and brush with the other egg, beaten.
Roast the chopped potatoes in the oil at 200C. After 10 minutes, add the wellington on a lined tray and bake 40 minutes until deep golden.
Meanwhile simmer the apples with the sugar and a splash of water until soft.
Rest the wellington. Melt the remaining butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and soy sauce for a gravy.

dishes.make_ahead: Steam the pudding up to 2 days ahead and reheat to serve; make the custard up to 1 day ahead and whip the cream on the night

steps.text: Steam the pudding over simmering water, or follow the packet.
Warm the milk with some of the cream. Whisk the yolks, sugar and cornflour, pour in the milk while whisking and return to the pan.
Stir until thick, then add the vanilla.
Whip the remaining cream with the icing sugar and orange zest.
Turn out the pudding, top with a holly sprig and serve with both.

dishes.make_ahead: Stud and roast the oranges up to 1 day ahead; heat the punch gently on the night

steps.text: Stud the oranges with the cloves and roast at 200C until browned.
Slice them into a saucepan with the grape juice, apple juice, cinnamon, honey and ginger.
Heat gently without boiling.
Ladle into heatproof glasses with an orange slice in each.
